verdicts.rationale: The only PPON name, 'Otsuka Pharmaceuticals UK Limited', is a form variant of the register's current name OTSUKA PHARMACEUTICALS (U.K.) LTD. The company-number side publishes the same name and the two orgs never appear as separate parties (0 cooccurring).
The PPON name 'Elekta Limited' matches the register's current name ELEKTA LIMITED exactly, apart from case. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence, so nothing points to a second entity.
Both sides publish only 'LISTER WILDER LIMITED', which is the register's current name. Five witnesses and zero cooccurrences make this one legal entity.

The PPON name 'Counterculture Partnership LLP' is exactly the register name COUNTERCULTURE PARTNERSHIP LLP, and the COH side's 'Counter Culture' is only a spacing variant of it. Three witnesses and no cooccurrence.

The PPON names 'Dennis Eagle' and 'Dennis Eagle Ltd' are the register's DENNIS EAGLE LIMITED. The COH side's 'Terberg Matec UK (A Trading Division of Dennis Eagle Ltd)' is a trading division of the same company, and 13 witnesses with no cooccurrence back the pair.

Both sides publish 'Ravensbourne Limited', which exactly matches the register's current name RAVENSBOURNE LIMITED. Company names are unique across the UK register, and there is no stray name or cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'NESTLE UK LTD.', which is the register's current name exactly. Two witnesses and no cooccurrence.

The PPON name 'MCO Healthcare Ltd' is the register's MCO HEALTHCARE LIMITED, and the COH side's 'mco healthcare' is the same name without its suffix. Each side has a single name and there is no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Denton Nickels UK Ltd' is a form variant (parentheses dropped) of the register's current name DENTON NICKELS (UK) LIMITED. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence.

The PPON name 'COGNIZANT WORLDWIDE LIMITED' is the register's current name. The COH side's 'Cognizant Technology Solutions (UK)' matches the previous name COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS UK LIMITED, and 5 witnesses with no cooccurrence back the pair.
Both sides publish 'Grundon Waste Management Limited', which is the register's current name GRUNDON WASTE MANAGEMENT LIMITED. Five witnesses and no cooccurrence.

The PPON name 'Brenntag (UK) Limited' is a parenthesised form variant of the register's BRENNTAG UK LIMITED. A Companies House search shows that the only entity that ever used 'BRENNTAG (U.K.)' (00969040) was dissolved in 2015, so no live sibling holds that form.
The PPON name 'NEW MEDIA WAREHOUSE LTD' is exactly the register's current name. The COH side adds only a trading name ('T/A Synergy Learning') of the same company.
The PPON name 'Bedcare Ltd T/a Reinforced Beds' is the register's BEDCARE LTD plus a trading name. The COH side publishes BEDCARE LTD, and 3 witnesses with no cooccurrence back the pair.

One of the two PPON names, 'Tetra Tech Limited', matches the register's current name, and 17 witnesses publish this PPON with 01959704 and never alongside it (0 cooccurring). A Companies House search shows the other PPON name, 'Tetra Tech Consulting Ltd', is a separate sister company (TETRA TECH CONSULTING LIMITED, formerly RPS Consulting Services), so that name is either a stray or a sign of a mixed-up PPON, and it does not meet the sample's claim that every PPON name matches the register. The notices behind that name would settle it: if they carry Tetra Tech Consulting's own company number, the PPON is contested.
Both sides publish 'New Dawn School Limited', which exactly matches the register's current name NEW DAWN SCHOOL LIMITED. There is no stray name or cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Elite Advanced Driver Training Ltd' is the register's ELITE ADVANCED DRIVER TRAINING LIMITED with only the suffix abbreviated. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence.

The PPON name 'Industrial Cleaning Equipment' is a short form of the register's INDUSTRIAL CLEANING EQUIPMENT (SOUTHAMPTON) LTD with the '(Southampton)' qualifier dropped, and a Companies House search finds no other live company of that name. Only one witness supports the pair, and a nearby Hampshire company (08214571, now Trade Cleaning Machines and Hire) was formerly 'Industrial Cleaning Equipment Rental Limited', so a second witness naming the Southampton company would lift this to high.
The PPON name 'Fieldhouse Engineering Ltd' is exactly the register's current name FIELDHOUSE ENGINEERING LTD. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence.

The PPON name 'Herbert Smith Freehills' is the register's previous name HERBERT SMITH FREEHILLS LLP. The LLP has since been renamed HERBERT SMITH FREEHILLS KRAMER LLP, and the COH side publishes both names, so this is a rename of one LLP.
The PPON name 'JAMES A. CUTHBERTSON, LIMITED (SC024322)' is the register's current name and even includes the company number. Four witnesses and no cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'Medecon Healthcare UK Ltd', the register's MEDECON HEALTHCARE UK LIMITED. There is no stray name or cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Hoistway Ltd' is the register's current name HOISTWAY LTD. Four witnesses and no cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'I.T. PROFESSIONAL SERVICES LIMITED', which exactly matches the register's current name. Four witnesses and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Lakeside Flood Solutions Ltd' is exactly the register's current name LAKESIDE FLOOD SOLUTIONS LTD. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Silvalea Ltd' is the register's current name SILVALEA LIMITED with the suffix abbreviated. Three witnesses and no cooccurrence.
The PPON names 'ALCIUM SOFTWARE LIMITED' and 'Alcium Software' are the register's current name and its suffix-less form. Four witnesses and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Efficient Energy Services Ltd' is exactly the register's EFFICIENT ENERGY SERVICES LTD. The COH side's 'Trading as Eco Giants' is a trading name of the same company.
Both sides publish 'Townsend and Renaudon LLP', which exactly matches the register's current name TOWNSEND AND RENAUDON LLP. There is no stray name or cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'Inclusivitii Limited', which exactly matches the register's current name INCLUSIVITII LIMITED. Two witnesses and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'AON Investments' is the register's current name AON INVESTMENTS LIMITED without the suffix, and the COH side publishes the full name. Two witnesses and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'NI Trucks Ltd' is exactly the register's current name NI TRUCKS LIMITED. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Walker Sime Ltd' is the register's current name WALKER SIME LIMITED. Seven witnesses and no cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'YTL CONSTRUCTION (UK) LIMITED', which exactly matches the register's current name. There is no stray name or cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'RED BADGER CONSULTING LIMITED', which exactly matches the register's current name. Two witnesses and no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'CLARANET LIMITED' is exactly the register's current name, and the COH side publishes the same name. Six witnesses and no cooccurrence.
Both sides publish 'VISION CONSULTING LIMITED', which exactly matches the register's current name. Company names are unique across the UK register, and there are 3 witnesses with no cooccurrence.
The PPON name 'Batson Groundcare Limited' is the register's current name BATSON GROUNDCARE LTD. There is one name per side and no cooccurrence.

The PPON names 'Great British Energy - Nuclear' and 'Great British Nuclear' are the register's current name and its previous name GREAT BRITISH NUCLEAR. Both sides publish the same pair of names, and 22 witnesses with no cooccurrence back the merge.
Both sides publish 'FUTURE PERFECT (HEALTHCARE) LIMITED', which exactly matches the register's current name. Two witnesses and no cooccurrence.
